integrity: The proof derives exact set filters for the product modality and the iterated coordinate modality directly from the published full-product definitions, proves their equality iff a rectangularization property holds, and independently proves the finite principal-filter corollary and an infinite reflexive counterexample. The 2026 primary full text and Kudinov 2014 were inspected for the same reverse-interaction or finite-eliminability result; none was located.
scientific_limitations: The characterization is pointwise for normal filter neighborhood frames. The finite corollary uses finiteness to make every filter principal. No claim is made for non-normal neighborhood semantics, and no claim is made that the rectangularization property is new as an abstract notion in filter theory.
title: Rectangularization exactly controls modality elimination in neighborhood full products
